messages:
alex: Heads-up — new org 'acme-data' requesting cross-cloud capacity. Need GPU quota + external IPs + egress bump for two projects (prod and staging). Raising this here so we can draft support tickets and tag requirements.

priya: Thanks. Can you list exact quota numbers per region and the IAM/billing tags they need? Also which cloud accounts (GCP/AWS) are we provisioning?

alex: GCP first (projects: acme-prod-usw1, acme-staging-euw1) but client may also want AWS as fallback. Requested quotas:
- us-west1: 16 x A100 80GB (accelerator quota)
- eu-west1: 8 x A100 80GB
- Ephemeral external IPs: 200 across both projects (prefer regional)
- Egress cap raise: 10 Gbps/project sustained
- VPC peering entries: 50

Also we need service-account roles: compute.admin (limited), iam.serviceAccountUser, and billing.resourceUsageViewer. Tagging: team=acme, cost_center=acme-prod (prod), acme-staging (staging).

matt: Cost note: 16 A100s reserved on GCP sustained will run ~X/day — I'll calc exact $ and post. Also consider asking for Dedicated capacity instead of raw quota if they're committing — will save costs and reduce preemption risk.

sarah: Heads-up on regional availability: eu-west1 has a known shortage for A100s this quarter. If support pushes back, fallback plan: request A2 VMs (a2-highgpu-1g) or allow us to place in europe-west4 temporarily. We should include a permissive fallback clause in the ticket: 'If A100 unavailable, allow equivalent quota for a2 machines or approve in europe-west4'.

alex: Good call. Drafting support ticket body now. Using the standard GCP quota template below — feel free to edit.

alex: ```
Project: acme-prod-usw1 (billing acme-prod)
Request: Increase accelerators.googleapis.com/quota for region us-west1 from 0 to 16 (A100 80GB)
Justification: Production ML inference workload for Redwood customer ACME; latency-sensitive, 24/7 inference. We intend to run long-lived reservation/Dedicated pool. Tagging requirements: labels team=acme, cost_center=acme-prod.
Fallback: If A100 unavailable in us-west1, approve equivalent A2 family quota or allow placement in europe-west4.
Additional requests: 100 ephemeral external IPs regional in us-west1; increase network egress cap to 10 Gbps.
Contact: Alex Rivera (alex@redwood.ai), Priya Iyer (priya@redwood.ai)
```

priya: Suggest adding estimated token throughput/requests per second to justify network egress (e.g., 2k reqs/s peak, ~3 TB/day). Also include that logs will be exported to GCS and retained 30d.

alex: Updated ticket snippet with throughput numbers. Also adding billing owner.

matt: I'll run quick cost calc and paste after lunch. For AWS side we should prepare equivalent limits: request for 8x p4d and 4x p4de per region + 200 Elastic IPs + ENI limit bump. Ops to decide whether to open both tickets in parallel or wait on GCP.

sarah: Ops recommendation: open GCP ticket first. If GCP response time >72h without positive capacity confirmation, open AWS fallback ticket with same wording. Also request a 'soft hold' with sales so they can prioritize capacity allocation.

infra-bot: FYI — quota-automation status: there is an automated request pipeline for accelerators, but regional capacity checks are manual. Use /quota-request template in #eng-infra to kick the pipeline.

devops-oncall: Quick checklist before submitting:
- Ensure billing account linked and active
- Add labels to project before quota approval
- Create service account and attach least-priv roles for compute ops
- Prepare patch network ACLs to allow IP range for control plane

alex: Submitting GCP ticket now (submitted ticket ID: 9876543210). Pasting support link + thread.

alex: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/9876543210

priya: Added IAM role list and labels to the ticket, pinged billing for confirmation.

matt: Cost estimate: rough monthly delta for requested GPUs ~ $XXk (on-demand), recommend reserved commitment or use Dedicated pool to shave ~30%. Posting spreadsheet link soon.

sarah: Noted escalation path if quota denied: 1) ask Google sales rep to reassign capacity 2) approve temp placement in europe-west4 3) fallback to T4s for staging only.

alex: Support updated ticket — quoting: 'Region us-west1 currently low on A100 capacity. Request placed in queue, estimated fulfillment 7-14 days.' Marking prod deploy timeline accordingly.

priya: Moving forward: I'll open the /quota-request in #eng-infra with the main ticket link and copy the AWS template in case we need to parallelize.

matt: thx. @sarah can you add a short runbook entry for 'quota denied' steps and where to move workloads? Small bullet list.

sarah: Yep will do and attach to the ticket.

alex: Closing loop — prod launch target delayed by 10 business days pending quota. Will update when GCP confirms or if we fallback to AWS. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

priya: SGTM :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reaction summary: :eyes: 6, :thumbsup: 4. Ticket 9876543210 status: In Progress.
